searchText: Hi friends me and <@!96996691282001920> are from the Filecoin team, here to discuss some fun EIP 1559 things Hi. I'm Kubuxu, one of the devs of Filecoin. As you probably heard we've implemented our version of EIP1559 in Filecoin. oh, looks like you got the introduction first ;p I'm sure we can exchange some knowledge. I have to say we for sure stress tested EIP1559 in our spacerace (a test network with real rewards). (about a million messages per day, with about 4 million *real* FIL on the line) I have one initial question: Why did you made inclusion of messages with FeeCap < BaseFee invalid? It seemed like a nice mechanic, allowing higher nonce messages cover too low FeeCap of earlier ones. Hi folks thanks for joining us. I'm excited to have you here.
